Interface ISpringWebSocket2AppAdapter

public interface ISpringWebSocket2AppAdapter
Adapter decoupling Spring's WebSocketHandler from the rest of the app, mirroring ballworld.springConfig.websocket.ISpringWebSocket2AppAdapter.
